title: Internet Of Things
definition: The Internet of Things (IoT) is an interconnected network of physical objects ("things") embedded with sensors, software, and other technologies for the purpose of connecting and exchanging data with other devices and systems over the internet.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC CSE GS Paper III (Science & Technology - Awareness in IT, Space, Computers, Robotics, Nanotechnology, Bio-technology) and Mains governance, smart cities, and agriculture applications.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Internet Of Things.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of computer networks, IP addressing, sensors, and cloud computing.
